verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SDKs across web, mobile, backend with a shared identity/event/consent model, plus HTTP V2 API for direct server-side ingestion and an auto-instrumentation wizard — supporting multi-platform event ingestion. However, evidence lacks a concrete list of named SDKs (e.g., specific language SDKs like Java, Python, Swift, Kotlin) or version/coverage details, and community feedback flags real-world integration difficulty and data accuracy issues. missing for 10: explicit enumeration of supported languages/platforms per SDK, independent hands-on confirmation of SDK reliability, and resolution of community-reported integration/data-quality complaints.
